biotools.summary: pyRBDome is a computational platform designed to enhance RNA-binding proteome data by aligning experimental results with machine-learning predictions and structural data. It provides statistical evaluation of RBDome data to identify likely RNA-binders and improve RBS detection through ensemble machine-learning models.
